description: This file contains a series of shell script tests related to updating index timestamps in Git, particularly focusing on handling racy timestamps during index refresh operations.

methods.name: reset_files
methods.description: Resets the test files 'file' and 'other' with specific content and sets their modification times.

methods.name: update_assert_changed
methods.description: Sets the '.git/index' file's mtime and attempts to update the index, asserting that the mtime has changed afterward.
